description:
Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.


Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.

It wraps Suwayomi's GraphQL API in a lightweight Tauri app — no Electron overhead.
# Moku v0.15.1
**Released:** November 16, 2026
> "History that keeps up."

## Highlights
• **Reading history works again**：new sessions show up right away, and stats no longer reset to zero after reopening Moku
• **Chapters from some sources load again**：pages that failed with HTTP 400 now open and download (Tsunagu#8)

## Improvements
• History and stats refresh when you open Home or History, or come back to the window, so sessions read on paired devices show up without restarting
• History from before 0.15.0 is now brought over in full, including titles read outside the library
• Installing an app APK instead of an extension now says so plainly instead of showing an internal error
• Arch install instructions now explain building the packages with `makepkg`, since neither is on the AUR
• Bundled Tsunagu updated to 0.8.1

## Bug Fixes
• Fixed reading stats resetting to zero on Windows and iOS
• Fixed history stopping recording after a single failed request to the server
• Fixed reading sessions not yet saved being lost when reconnecting to the server
• Fixed a failed stats request leaving the history list empty
• Fixed the History tab's "All" filter hiding sessions

## Notes
• Update Moku for Android to get the same fixes on your phone
• Arch：build Tsunagu 0.8.1 before Moku, as the package now requires it
